结束一切战争的战争！（结束一切战争的战争！（第22页）她忽然记起前世的一件事情，那是在一次任务中，她碰到一个浑身溃烂的叫花子，莫名的，就是被那双眼睛里的戾气和不甘吸引，难得动了一次恻隐之心，救了那人。不过叔叔那两个字却是再喊不出口了，别人都指明了你和辛蕊是同学，那就不能从罗雨薇身上论关系了。而失联的飞机正好被卷入了其中，以夏浩然的推测，那些人十有八九已经被撕成碎片了。因为，这种天地异象远比那种龙卷风犀利多了，被卷进那玩意里，还有活路？富察芷珊听他如此夸自己，只觉得又喜又窘，脸颊愈发的滚烫了起来，面前的男子只着了一件简单的月白缎绣兰芝的长衫，却是说不出的俊雅卓然，温润非凡。果然。和他和颜渊的情况一样。这明显是在拖延时间，到底是谁？一时间大堂里的众人都产生了一种错觉，自己是不是来错地方了？这里莫非是国外某个豪门皇族在举行聚会？而华夏国在经过一番炮轰烂炸，并率先占据了道德和舆论的制高点时，同时，也在第一时间积极响应，组织起搜救团队，进入“险地”全力展开生命营救工作。要知道，去别人家里看货，一般都是行内人，毕竟是去谈买卖的，而且地点又很敏感。赵子弦松了松一口闷气，故作镇定地看了一眼叶母和叶灵珊，只见叶母双手环抱着叶灵珊，手掌轻轻地抚摸着叶灵珊的脸颊，一副慈母的样子。看得赵子弦也有点不忍心了。心中汹涌而来的情绪，伴随着他的脚步声，一点一滴的蜇待复苏。就算他能舍得娇妻幼子，和那个即将到来的孩子。只怕皇帝也不放心，他们父子两人双双离京而去。

Chapter 207 The War to End All Wars (Page 1)
The war to end all wars! (The war to end all wars! (Page 22)) She suddenly remembered an incident in her previous life. During a mission, she met a beggar with ulcers all over his body. Inexplicably, she was attracted by the violence and unwillingness in those eyes. It was rare. I felt compassion and saved the man. However, I couldn't say the word "uncle" anymore. Others pointed out that you and Xin Rui were classmates, so you couldn't talk about the relationship based on Luo Yuwei, and the missing plane happened to be involved. Haoran speculated that those people had probably been torn into pieces, because this kind of heaven and earth phenomenon was much sharper than that kind of tornado. How could they still survive after being sucked into that thing? Fucha Zhishan felt happy and embarrassed when he heard him praise herself like this. His cheeks were getting hotter. The man in front of him was only wearing a simple moon-white satin embroidered Lanzhi gown, but he was indescribably elegant and gentle. As expected, this was obviously stalling for time. Who? Everyone in the lobby suddenly had the illusion that they were in the wrong place? Could it be that a wealthy family from abroad was holding a party? After a lot of bombardment, Huaxia took the lead in taking the commanding heights of morality and public opinion. At the same time, it also responded immediately and organized a search and rescue team to enter the "dangerous area" to carry out life-saving work. You know, people who go to other people's homes to see goods are usually people in the industry, and the location is. And very sensitive. Zhao Zixian breathed a sigh of relief and glanced at Ye Mu and Ye Lingshan pretending to be calm. He saw Ye Mu holding Ye Lingshan's arms and gently stroking Ye Lingshan's cheek, looking a little motherly. He couldn't bear it. The emotions surging in his heart were stinging him bit by bit. Even if he could let go of his beloved wife and son, the emperor would not be worried, so both father and son left the capital.
